fusions.name: Frayed Pellet
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, one spent on each throw and one returned by each kill. Throws a pellet of loose thread that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Skittering Rush
fusions.desc: Looses 3 threads at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage and stunning the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hooded Hem
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Slip Stitch
fusions.desc: After you have moved far enough, you gain a ward that soaks 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
